verdict.rationale: The Crossplane CLI documents testing and rendering Composition Functions without access to a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane, which gives an offline way to check configuration without touching live infrastructure. That covers only composition logic. There is no evidence of a dedicated sandbox environment or of isolating production data while testing real provisioning. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or non-production environment mode, guidance on isolating production data and credentials during tests, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the offline render/test workflow.
